development_choices.choice: No automatic uploader content readback. Future normal internal inspection requires current scan evidence plus exact designated human clearance; a separately granted quarantine-inspection route may bypass only ordinary visibility restriction after malware pass. The reservation-only increment exposes none of those byte routes.
development_choices.rationale: Separates receipt, security review and document release, avoids turning uploader ownership or technical roles into content authority, and keeps all real-file handling gated under the existing no-PHI decision.
development_choices.activation_gate: Before real grants/uploads, approve designated actors, safe inspection environment, incident contact and false-positive handling. OD-001/003 audiences and DOC-001 professional/release authority remain independent and unapproved.

development_choices.choice: The synthetic reservation configuration is private and disabled by default, with text/plain and at most 65536 requested bytes. A default 900-second reservation TTL is configurable within a 1..3600-second test bound; expiry never deletes a record or grants content access.
development_choices.rationale: Small reproducible engineering limits exercise safe state and authorization without inventing a product-format promise, retention schedule or scientific threshold. Trusted configuration does not replace current identity/membership/capability checks.
development_choices.activation_gate: Synthetic development only. Real uploads still require OD-013 handling approval and actual gateway/Storage/scanner/security/restore acceptance; limits must be reviewed for the selected live workload.

development_choices.choice: Only the exact existing development project defaults Edge transport to synthetic-only with exact localhost/127.0.0.1 port4179 origins. Invalid target/origin/mode disables transport; explicit empty origins clear CORS access. Separate SQL reservation enablement and verified private bucket remain required.
development_choices.rationale: Nonsecret bounded development configuration permits the authorized integration without enabling a production project, arbitrary web origin, bucket creation or real uploads.
development_choices.activation_gate: Development synthetic payloads only. Real file handling still requires designated people/procedure, scanner/provider and full authorization/recovery acceptance under OD-013.

development_choices.choice: Only typed synthetic_fixture scan observations are accepted. development_choices.rationale: Exercises the complete security transition and UI failure behavior while neither inventing scanner effectiveness nor exposing sensitive content. Current eligibility never grants download, adoption or release.
development_choices.activation_gate: No real scanner/PHI processing or human grant is approved. Live actors, safe inspection, handling procedure and actual runtime/provider/restore evidence remain required; OD001/003 document and professional authority remain independent.
